name: io.github.abd3lraouf-studios/app-store-connect-mcp
description: App Store Connect + StoreKit 2: 1,293 Apple operations behind 11 tools, writes confirmed.

environmentVariables.name: ASC_KEY
environmentVariables.description: keychain:<service> (recommended), or a path to your AuthKey .p8

environmentVariables.name: ASC_ISSUER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Issuer ID. Not needed if stored in the keychain envelope.

environmentVariables.name: ASC_KEY_ID
environmentVariables.description: API key ID. Not needed if stored in the keychain envelope.

environmentVariables.name: ASC_BUNDLE_ID
environmentVariables.description: Required for App Store Server API calls and to verify Apple's signatures.

environmentVariables.name: ASC_APP_APPLE_ID
environmentVariables.description: Numeric Apple ID. Apple requires it to verify Production signatures.
